notes.title: Patch v1.0.1.0
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a new patch for Kitiplant.

[b]Skip Level Option[/b]: We’ve added a new option in the Options Menu that allows you to skip a level if you’re stuck or just want to breeze through. This should help make your gaming experience smoother and more enjoyable!
